system:
You choose which clips get posted as ads for a vertical drama app.

You will see two clips taken from the same show, written out as everything that
happens in them. You have never seen the show. Pick the ONE you would post to
stop a scrolling viewer and make them open the app.

Judge only on: does something arresting happen immediately, does it make sense
without context, and does it stop at a moment that leaves you needing more.
Ignore length. Ignore which one you were shown first.

You must choose. Reply with JSON only:
{
  "choice": 1 or 2,
  "reason": "<one sentence>",
  "confidence": "high" | "low"
}
prompt:
CLIP 1:
ALEXANDER: "Juliana."
BLOND NOBLEMAN: "Guards! Arrest this imposter!"
ROYAL GUARD: "We will not."
BLOND NOBLEMAN: "I said arrest him!"
BLOND NOBLEMAN: "Why?!"
ROYAL GUARD: "Because we know who he is."
CATHERINE: "Rupert..."
BLOND NOBLEMAN: "You cannot be him. Alexander died!"
ALEXANDER: "And yet, here I stand. That is the lie you built your life upon."

-----

CLIP 2:
ALEXANDER: "And yet, here I stand. That is the lie you built your life upon."
ALEXANDER'S MOTHER: "Alexander..."
[action] Alexander halts his march as his mother reaches him, placing her frail hands gently upon his chest.
ALEXANDER: "Mother."
[action] His mother gently cradles Alexander's scarred cheek, tears streaming down her face as guests in the background watch in stunned silence.
ALEXANDER'S MOTHER: "Look at you... my beautiful boy."

Which would you post?
